about_short_description.short_description: dltHub is building an open source Python library called data load tool (dlt).

product.name: dlt (data load tool)
product.description: An open-source Python library for creating data ingestion pipelines that load data from various sources into structured datasets without requiring backends or containers.

product.name: REST API Source toolkit
product.description: A Python-based declarative configuration system and client for building data pipelines from REST APIs, enabling reusable and adaptable pipeline creation.

product.name: dlt-dbt runner
product.description: A tool that integrates dlt data loading pipelines with dbt transformations, enabling combined data ingestion and modeling in cloud environments like Google Cloud Functions.

identifier.value: Row and Column Level Lineage with dlt

product.name: Row and Column Level Lineage with dlt
product.description: A feature within dlt that tracks data provenance at both row and column levels, enabling detailed lineage and metadata management for data pipelines.

product.name: Schema Evolution in dlt
product.description: An automated process in dlt that infers, versions, and manages changes in data schemas to maintain structured and consistent data ingestion over time.
